text:
nova_pm: Quick ask for the Jun12 webinar launch lane — need a small, production-ready asset set for ads + deck.

nova_pm: Must-haves: 1) Landing hero (1600x600) + email hero (1200x628) static, 2) 140 slide for the deck (1920x1080) with a benchmark scatter (latency ms vs $/1k tokens) annotated for Hosted/Dedicated/Private, 3) three social tiles (square, story loop small, linkedin banner), 4) an SVG micro-diagram illustrating routing+cache. Localize EN/FR/DE.

chez_design: Copy or visual direction we should follow?

alix_copy: Primary headline "Predictable latency, cost-aware inference". Alt headline "Ship LLM features without guesswork". Subhead "Jun 12 webinar: demo + benchmark". CTA variants: "Register" / "Save my seat". I'll provide translated strings by tomorrow 9am PT.

mina_i18n: Please keep every string in its own editable text layer and avoid text in flattened images. Provide a CSV export page in Figma. That speeds FR/DE turnaround.

chez_design: For the benchmark viz: do you want gridlines and numeric ticks?
nova_pm: Keep ticks & axis labels but minimal grid. Use teal + warm orange for points/accents; avoid alarm red (#c63232). Annotate a small callout: "smart routing & caching reduces effective unit cost".

tim_legal: No competitor logos. If using any customer names/quotes, attach signed permission. Also flag any hard % claims  we need a data source.

chez_design: I'll set up the Figma file with separate pages per locale and export presets (PNG for email/web, WebP for social, SVG for diagrams, PDF for deck). ETA initial comps: tomorrow 11am PT.

export-bot: Figma file created: Jun12-Launch-Assets (placeholder link). Frames: hero-1600x600, hero-email-1200x628, slide-1920x1080, diagram-svg, social-square-1080x1080, social-story-1080x1920, linkedin-1200x627.

alix_copy: I'll drop alt text and two micro-CTA variants by 8:30am PT.

mina_i18n: Once source copy is in, FR/DE should be doable within 12 hours if strings are concise. Keep CTAs <20 chars.

nova_pm: Priority order: 1) landing hero + CTA, 2) benchmark slide, 3) social tiles. Ping legal for quick brand check on finals. Any blockers, flag here. :rocket:
